name: annas-mcp
description: Search Anna's Archive for books and papers and download the file you pick.
long_description: Search Anna's Archive for books, textbooks, manuals, standards and journal articles by title, author, topic or DOI, then download the copy you pick into a local folder. Requires an Anna's Archive membership. On first run the bundle downloads the matching annas-mcp release binary from GitHub, verifies its SHA-256 checksum and caches it.

tools.name: book_search
tools.description: Find books, textbooks, manuals and standards by title, author or topic

tools.name: article_search
tools.description: Find journal articles by keyword, or look one up by DOI

tools.name: book_download
tools.description: Download a book using the hash from a search result

tools.name: article_download
tools.description: Download an article by DOI or hash

account_cookie.title: Account cookie (aa_account_id2)
account_cookie.description: The aa_account_id2 cookie from a signed-in Anna's Archive browser session. It expires weekly.

secret_key.description: Your Anna's Archive API key, from your account page. Needed for downloads.
